I'm Rafin, a BSc Computer Science & Engineering student at Trust University, Barishal, with 4+ years of experience as a Virtual Assistant — admin support, data analysis and customer service for international clients, including an international tutoring company, plus a year in e-commerce with Shopify and social media. I'm open to admin support, data analysis, e-commerce and social media roles where I can bring structure, consistency and care to the work.

RedLife — Trust University Barishal Campus Blood Donation Network

Founded & built by Rafsan Rafin

RedLife connects Trust University students who are ready to donate blood with people facing emergency requests. Donors register with their blood group, the network matches compatible donors to each request, and eligible donors are notified inside the site — so help can reach a patient faster.

RoleFounder & builder TypeLive web platform ForTrust University, Barishal campus
01Donor directorySearch registered campus donors by blood group and availability.
02Emergency requestsRequests notify compatible blood groups only — for example, an A+ request alerts A+, A−, O+ and O− donors.
03Safe eligibilityA donor becomes eligible again 3 months after their last donation, shown clearly on every profile.
Visit RedLife live ↗ redlife.mooo.com
